name: film-cartridge
prompt: Neutral reference photograph for 3D reconstruction: one generic, unbranded 35mm film cartridge standing upright, three-quarter view from slightly above, centered and fully visible, isolated on a plain light grey seamless background with soft even studio light and a faint contact shadow. Cylindrical body of plain brushed dark gunmetal metal with no label at all, matte black plastic end caps at top and bottom, a short spool stub protruding from the top cap, and a short dark amber film leader tongue extending from the side slot. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no stickers, no barcodes, no printed patterns. Sharp focus, realistic proportions.
license: AI-generated in the owner-operated Higgsfield account (Plus plan). The Higgsfield MCP exposes no per-model licence/commercial-use field; usage rights follow Higgsfield and upstream provider terms — confirm before production. Generic, unbranded; not a merchant product, not documentary.

bounds.note: Y-up, normalized to 1 unit tall, bbox-centred (body axis sits slightly off origin because the leader extends to one side).

loaderRequirements: Plain three GLTFLoader (r186 handles EXT_texture_webp natively). No Draco/Meshopt/KTX2.
renderingNotes: Material is metallic=1/roughness=1 driven by the ORM texture; without an environment map (e.g. PMREM RoomEnvironment) the body renders very dark — give it an env map or a soft key light.
usage: Decorative hero/lab accent prop (e.g. slow bounded rotation next to film-lab copy).
fallback: Procedural Three.js cartridge or static poster; hide on reduced-motion/low-power if desired.
status: in production: home hero 3D workspace (desktop, after first engagement)
